messages:
Nadia (Hiring Manager): New PM Jordan starts Mon 9am PT. Need a short manager one-pager + a tiny 30/60/90 to paste into the offer email.
Leo (People Ops): Copy/paste friendly one-pager below. Will keep it tight.
Rae (IT): IT note: confirm mac/linux and AWS access. We image 48h prior. If invites fail open @it-help with a screenshot. If laptop delayed use https://devbox.redwood.internal (request via @it-help).
Ivy (Buddy): I'll be the buddy. Can do 30m intro + 1:1 shadow on Day 3. I'll post a welcome in #product.
Leo (People Ops): MANAGER ONE-PAGER (pasteable)
- Pre-boarding: confirm laptop choice, shipping address, and personal email for calendar invites.
- Day 1 AM: 9:00 welcome w/manager (15m), team intro (30m), IT handoff (15m), lunch w/buddy.
- Day 1 PM: HR overview (15m), enable Okta/MFA, grant repo read access, assign a 1-week mini deliverable (1-page problem statement).
- Days 2-5: product deep dives, shadowing sessions, and access checks.
- End of week 2: draft 30/60/90 and review with manager.

WHO TO CONTACT:
- IT: @it-help 1 laptop & access
- Security: @security_ops 1 SSO/MFA
- Payroll/Benefits: @people-ops 1 forms
- Buddy: @Ivy 1 day-to-day

30/60/90 (one-line prompts)
- 30 days: onboarded with read access, delivered a scoped onboarding task, met core stakeholders.
- 60 days: own a medium-sized deliverable, show early metric improvements, deepen cross-team relationships.
- 90 days: deliver measurable impact aligned to OKRs, independently run planning and demos.

Leo (People Ops): MANAGER COMMITMENTS: weekly 1:1 (30m) for 12 weeks; schedule 30/60/90 checkpoints; provide feedback within 10 business days.
Rae (IT): Access note: view access to staging by Day 2; deploy rights after manager + security approval.
Ivy (Buddy): Channel welcome template: "Welcome @Jordan! Jordan joins as PM Mon 9am PT. Buddy: @Ivy. Quick intro 9:30 then lunch." :tada:
Jordan (New hire): Thanks all! Quick Q: analytics access Day 1?
Rae (IT): Typically view access by Day 2. If you need Day 1, open @it-help and cc your manager.
Nadia (Hiring Manager): Leo, can you paste a one-line offer blurb I can include?
Leo (People Ops): Offer blurb: "Welcome to Redwood! Attached is a short first-week agenda and a starter 30/60/90. We'll provision accounts before Day 1; for setup help contact @it-help. Your buddy @Ivy will meet you for lunch on Day 1. Excited to have you aboard!"
Nadia (Hiring Manager): Perfect 1 sending now. Thanks team :rocket:
